fields.meta_title: Nomination Form Builder With Judge Scoring | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a nomination form that tallies nominations by nominee, lets judges score each one, and reminds people before entries close. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Nomination Form Your Judges Can Score
fields.hero_description: Build a nomination form that counts nominations by nominee and saves each one to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Happens to Each Nomination After Submit
fields.features_subheading: A nomination form puts someone forward for an award or a seat. These six parts decide how each one is counted and read.
fields.feature_1:
One specific moment for every nominee

The form asks for the nominee, the category, and one moment that earned the nomination, with a rough date. Judges then get a story they can check, not a line of praise.
fields.feature_2:
Nominations grouped under each name

Each nomination is saved as a row in a database you own, and the app counts the rows per nominee. Three nominations for one coworker sit under one name, each with a reason.
fields.feature_3:
A scoring page for the judges

Judges score each nomination on their own page against the criteria you set, such as impact or teamwork. The app averages the scores and ranks the nominations for the meeting.
fields.feature_4:
Reminders before nominations close

An email or Slack reminder goes to anyone on your list who has not nominated, a set number of days before the close. At the close, the organizer gets the final count by email.
fields.feature_5:
Short screens for staff away from a desk

The form can show one question per screen for people nominating on a phone, such as a warehouse worker on a lunch break or a teacher with a few minutes between classes.
fields.feature_6:
Code your IT team can read

Emergent exports the code of the form, the judges' page, and the database to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A developer can add an award category in a pull request.

fields.usecase_heading: What Four Programs Do With Nominations
fields.tab_content_1:
Every nomination for the month lands with HR on the last day

Anyone at Brackwell Freight's warehouse can nominate a coworker for employee of the month. In September the form took 23 nominations, 7 of them for forklift lead Imani Castellow. On the last day of the month, HR manager Corinne Slate gets a Slack direct message with the tally and every written reason.
fields.tab_content_2:
A 4.3 average from three judges shortlists Northgate Clinic

The Halvern Builders Association takes award nominations in 4 categories. Three judges score each nomination out of 5, and an average of 4.0 or higher makes the shortlist. Northgate Clinic scored 4, 5, and 4, an average of 4.3. Its builder, Strand and Mayer Construction, gets an email saying it made the shortlist.
fields.tab_content_3:
Nominees say yes or no before the ballot

Linden Court Homeowners Association has 3 board seats open, and any member can nominate a neighbor. Each of the 8 nominees gets an email asking them to accept or decline. Five accepted and 3 declined. The ballot the secretary sends to members lists 5 names for the 3 seats.
fields.tab_content_4:
An email nudges teachers still without a pick

Ashgrove Middle School asks its 31 teachers to nominate up to 2 students each for Student of the Quarter, and nominations close on Thursday. By Monday, 24 teachers had nominated. The 7 who had not got an email reminder with the form link.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Nomination Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a nomination form that draws specific stories and gets each one scored, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down what the award is for
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask for a moment, not adjectives
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Pick the judges and the criteria
fields.howto_step_1_des: Name the award, who can be nominated, and who can nominate, in two sentences. Put that text at the top of the form. A nominator then knows the rules before the first question, and an ineligible nomination is easy to spot.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Replace the open why-do-they-deserve-it box with a prompt for something the nominee did and who saw it. Judges can weigh two stories against each other. Two lists of praise read the same.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Choose who reads the nominations before the form opens, and write the criteria each judge scores against, such as impact or teamwork. Score out of 5, and set the average a nomination needs to reach the shortlist.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Paste the eligibility text and the questions into one prompt, with the scoring rule. Emergent builds the form with its nomination database and the judges' page. To add a category later, ask for it in a new prompt.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Set the close date and the reminder
fields.howto_step_5_des: Pick the close date and the list of people expected to nominate. Put the close date in the reminder's subject line and the form link in its first sentence, and send it to everyone who has not nominated.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Draft the note each nominee receives, win or not, before the results come in. Thank every nominee by name and quote a line from their nomination where you can. Tell the finalists before the ceremony.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Submit 3 nominations: 2 for the same person and 1 with the reason left blank. Check that the tally puts 2 under one name, that judges see all 3, and that the reminder list drops you. Delete the test rows before launch.

faq_plan.a: A nomination form is the form someone fills in to put another person forward for an award or an elected seat. It records who is nominated and why, and it goes to whoever picks the winner.

faq_plan.q: How to create a nomination form?
faq_plan.ref: how to create a nomination form
faq_plan.a: Decide what the award rewards and who will score the entries. Describe those to Emergent's AI form builder in plain English, and it builds the nomination form with a database for the entries and a page for the judges. Then send the link to everyone who can nominate.

faq_plan.q: What should a nomination form include?
faq_plan.ref: what is nomination form in passport application
faq_plan.a: The nominee's name and the award category, plus a short account of what the nominee did. Ask for the nominator's contact details too, in case a judge has a question. Add an eligibility checkbox if the award has a rule, such as a year with the company. Emergent builds whichever of these fields you list in the prompt.

faq_plan.q: What nominee fields does a nomination form need?
faq_plan.ref: is nomination form required for passport
faq_plan.a: Only enough to identify the nominee: a name, a team or department, and an email if the award takes outside nominees. Leave out home addresses and staff ID numbers. Collect those in an employee information form instead, and pull them only for the winner.

faq_plan.q: Can someone send a nomination form for themselves?
faq_plan.ref: what is a beneficiary nomination form
faq_plan.a: Yes, when your rules allow self-nominations. Decide before launch and say it in the form's opening line. If you allow them, add a checkbox that marks a nomination as a self-nomination, and judges can read those with that in mind.

faq_plan.q: How many nominations can a nomination form collect?
faq_plan.ref: what is a pension nomination form
faq_plan.a: As many as people send: forms built with Emergent have no response caps. To limit nominations per person instead, such as 2 each, say it in the prompt, and the form turns away a third nomination from the same nominator.

faq_plan.q: What questions should an employee of the month nomination form ask?
faq_plan.ref: employee of the month nomination form
faq_plan.a: The nominee's name and one thing they did that month that a coworker noticed, with a rough date. Ask for the nominator's name unless nominations are anonymous. Keep ratings off it: those belong in an employee evaluation form, not in praise from peers.

faq_plan.q: Can I reuse a nomination form template every year?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Keep one nomination form template and change the categories and the close date before each round. Earlier rounds remain in your own database, where a judge can check whether someone was put forward before.

faq_plan.q: What should I write on a nomination form for a coworker?
faq_plan.ref: how to fill beneficiary nomination form
faq_plan.a: Write about one specific moment: what they did and what changed because of it. Add a number if you have one, such as orders shipped on a short-staffed day. Write two or three sentences like that rather than a paragraph of praise.

faq_plan.q: How do I fill out a nomination form?
faq_plan.a: Read the eligibility rules at the top first. Then fill in the nominee's details and your own, and write the reason last. Stick to facts the judges can check, the way an accident report form sticks to what happened and when. Submit before the close date.

plan.angle: The top 10 is template galleries (Microsoft Forms, Jotform, Formsite, SurveyMonkey, formuiz), one live track and field awards form, a university Word file and a legal glossary entry. Every one stops when the nominator clicks submit. This page shows what a nomination form does with the nominations afterward, in four programs a searcher will recognize: a freight warehouse tallying employee of the month nominations for HR, a builders association whose judges score nominations onto a shortlist, a homeowners association that asks each nominee to accept before the ballot, and a middle school that reminds teachers who have not nominated. The FAQ answers the definition, what to include, self-nominations, nomination counts, templates and how to fill one out.
